profile.headline: Software Engineer at Tata Consultancy Services
profile.summary: Obtain a Programmer Analyst position with an organization where I will be working on challenging projects while utilizing my skills in programming, database design and computer applications to help organization to achieve their goals..

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Client: Home Depot
Hybris is an e-Commerce multichannel platform developed with Java frameworks Spring MVC, Hibernate and other front end technologies like HTML, XML, JSTL, Java Script, JSON and Ajax. Using Hybris framework one can create a web shop and customize its behavior.
• CMS Components for various templates, page navigation, links, menus.
• Checkout - Cart, Order confirmation and Order summery functionality.
• Added custom Html5, CSS, and JavaScript for enhanced user experience, Rebranding Website.
• Customizing HMC and Product Cockpit.
• Use shell script to run and test.
TCS Internal Project (SAP Enterprise solution Unit)
• Involved in various phases of Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) as requirement gathering, modeling, analysis, architecture design and development.
• Developed the web tier using JSP, Spring MVC
• Used Spring Framework for the Implementation of the Application. Implemented various design patterns like Factory and Singleton.
• Used advanced core java features like annotations, generics, enhanced for loop etc. throughout the application.
• Used various Core Java concepts such as Exception Handling, Collection API to implement various features and enhancements.
• Mapped business objects to database using Hibernate, Used JPA annotations to Map DB to Objects.
• Deployed the Application in WebSphere server.
• Used Eclipse as the IDE for development
• Maven is used as the build tool.
• Created unit test cases and mock objects using JUnit framework.
• User Eclipse Toolkit to extend Fiori Apps.
• Built the Core Framework for cross-app communication, user preferences & navigation.
• Integrated Gateway oData/JSON services with UI5 Apps.
• Custom Apps Development using UI5, JavaScript, JQuery.
• Use D3 JavaScript Libraries to build visualization for customer.
• Routing, Models, Component, and Data Binding.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Develop financial modules end to end for the loan process.
Using Spring Boot Framework, developed a web-based application.
Used AngularJS, Bootstrap,HTML5 , CSS3, JavaScript for rich user interface
Created tables,function,views and producers on Oracle Database
Tracked all tickets thru Jira and used Git to merge code.
Used jenkins for release to Dev and UAT.

positions.title: Software Developer (Consultant)
positions.description:
• Interacted with clients to understand their existing applications and design the site according to their system requirements.
• Participated in day-to-day meeting, status meeting, strong reporting and effective communication with project manager and developers
• Hands on experience in application development using Struts framework.
• Strong exposure working with J2EE design patterns like MVC, Front Controller, and Singleton.
• Having much knowledge in OOPs Concepts.
• Proficiency in programming with Java IDE's like Eclipse.
• Good Working Knowledge of Servers like WebSphere 8.5, Apache Tomcat. 
• Involved in developing the UI pages using HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, JSON, jQuery, Ajax
• Used AngularJS, Bootstrap for rich user interface.
• Used Angular plugins for Tree structure, Data table, Drag-and-Drop, Widgets, Menus, User Interface and Forms.
• Used Bootstrap Framework to make page responsive.

positions.title: System Engineer
positions.description:
•	Support Carrier Validation Team to test 2G/3G/4G (LTE) mobile handsets to verify Carrier's Requirement and Acceptance plan.
•	Experience with wireless communication test sets (Anite network simulators).  
	Test and debug device related issues on LTE, WCDMA and CDMA platforms
	Troubleshoot and Analyze protocol logs, report issues and work with the development team to get them fixed
	Execute VZW carrier specific test suites on Network Simulators which include LTE Data Retry, IMS 
Registration and Retry, Multi-Mode Data Retry, LTE CDMA IRAT, LTE data TPUT, CCF certification test plans etc.

positions.title: IT
positions.description:
•	Outlook: Create new Outlook Profiles for All users in Artnet.
•	Inventory all PCs, Monitors, VOIP phones and associate them with Desktop Central.
•	Troubleshooting Printers.
•	Installing and deploying new PCs/Monitors/Phones and adding
•	Configuring Graphics Card /installing softwares and deploying dual monitor capabilities
•	Troubleshooting users PCs for Viruses, Spywares / Managing Helpdesk Ticketing tool / Creating Purchase orders.
•	Imaging / Cloning / PCs through Acronis Backup and imaging Solutions Software.
•	Wire management / Cables / Relabeling and Rewiring / Rerouting and reseating Network Racks and cables.

skills.name: Java, C, SQL, XML, PHP, HTML, Web Development, Eclipse IDE.
